verdict.rationale: Bento is an email platform with built-in AI features, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents Bento's own hosted MCP server, which lets outside AI assistants use Bento's tools. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. Nothing shows Bento itself can connect to third-party MCP servers or use their tools.
